race.comment: SILK SONIC (8) battled on a heavy track over 870m here 3 weeks ago, where she never really threatened. The jockey that day felt her action was not right, so did not knock her around. Ryan Wiggins takes over, and she can make amends. Follow your money. DEEP TIARA (9) was doing her best work late when fourth over 1110m at this venue, making ground from well back. She will get a genuine tempo here, and can have the last say. SPEEDY ONE (1) caught the eye fresh up, travelling well into the straight before blowing out late. His perfect record of 3 wins from 3 second-up attempts is hard to ignore, and he should be hard to peg back again. THATS ARCHIES GIRL (5) has been around the money without landing a blow, but her recent efforts have been competitive enough to suggest an overdue win isn't far away. The removal of blinkers may help her settle better, and a recent trial win makes her a top 3 chance here.
